propositions: When acceptance criteria no longer match reality due to subsequent codebase changes, the only documented close path is --force-close or --ref to an old commit, both leaving inaccurate ticket state.

The completion verifier has no legitimate audited path to mark criteria as invalidated-by-fix or auto-generated/unverifiable, forcing either closure against false criteria or costly re-review of already-executed work.
The plan-review close gate's stale-regver check blocks closure of completed work when the criteria registry changes post-plan-review, requiring a full billable re-review of an already-shipped plan.

Documentation must establish that editing stale criteria, re-passing plan review, and closing against corrected criteria is the sanctioned remedy, while --force-close and --ref to old commits leave inaccurate permanent records.
